name: Discovery Early Career Researcher Award (DECRA)
amount: Salary contribution about AUD 126,693/year (incl. on-costs) + up to AUD 50,000/year project funds
other_rules: PhD awarded within the last 5 years (DE27: on or after 1 March 2021) unless an eligibility exemption is approved for career disruption
submitted by an eligible Australian university
ARC Medical Research Policy applies (most clinical and medical research belongs with NHMRC)
notes: DE27 round closed 11 Mar 2026 (university internal deadlines about a month earlier). Up to 200 awards a year. ARC has signalled changes to the scheme for future rounds.
